rule.name: SpringTransactionalCheckedRollback
rule.message: Add rollbackFor = Exception.class to this @Transactional, or throw an unchecked exception. A checked exception commits the work done so far instead of rolling it back.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ ThrowsList/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Throwable')] [not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.RuntimeException') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Error'))]] [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] [not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = ('rollbackFor', 'rollbackForClassName')])] [not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'readOnly']/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()])] or (@Visibility = 'public' and not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')]) and ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] [not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = ('rollbackFor', 'rollbackForClassName')])] [not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'readOnly']/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()])])] /ThrowsList
